deadline.value: The early fall deadline is February 15, 2027, which is also the cutoff for teaching assistantship consideration.
deadline.quote: February 15 (early), April 15 (regular), and July 15 (late) for fall semester

also.quote: All application materials must be received no later than February 15 in order to be considered for a teaching assistantship appointment

gre_general.value: The program pages do not mention the GRE.

gre_subject.value: The program pages do not mention a GRE Mathematics subject test.

supervisor.value: Admission is by committee; a dissertation adviser is chosen after entry.
supervisor.quote: Prior to the formation of the committee, the student will suggest one faculty member

funding.value: Teaching associate positions go to well-qualified students and cover tuition and fees for up to 24 credits plus a stipend.
funding.quote: Teaching Associate positions available to well-qualified full-time students

also.quote: Teaching Associates receive a full tuition and fee award for up to 24 credits, and an additional stipend

entry_route.value: A bachelor's from a regionally accredited institution with at least a 3.0 GPA is enough; a prior master's can count for up to 32 credits.
entry_route.quote: A bachelor’s degree from a regionally-accredited institution with at least a 3.0 grade-point average

also.quote: A maximum of 32 credits may be applied
